title: A row cell note counts toward the row's height
body: A `note` under a row cell draws below the cell, but neither the cell's height nor the space a `stack` gives the row counts it. In `figures/sufr-build.acre` the rank table needed a spacer box under it, and the merge rows of section 9 gave every cell a blank note so their numbers line up. The proposal is that a row with notes is as tall as its tallest note reaches.
